name: CorroborateMe API
description:
Prove end users to agents and apps

Consumers are **any** HTTP client: backend services, SPAs, mobile apps, scripts, or AI agents.
Agents are optional. The same REST surface powers console sessions, API keys, and login-links.
OIDC is live: register clients at /api/oidc/clients; discovery at /api/auth/.well-known/openid-configuration; JWKS at /api/auth/jwks. Interactive login bridges through login-link (company_users).

Auth: Bearer session JWT (console), company end-user JWT (login-link IdP), or API key (`aa_...`).
Interactive UI: https://corroborateme.com/swagger | Agent index: https://corroborateme.com/llms.txt | Human guide: https://corroborateme.com/docs | MCP directories package: https://github.com/CNR-Consulting/corroborate-me
